reading: The regular crossed lattice is visible in baseline and roughness-constant-only. It disappears in normal-unlinked-only while the annular raised-region geometry and the broad studio reflections remain. This independently supports the baked normal map as the dominant visible cause under these fixed diagnostic conditions. The normal-unlinked image is a control, not an accepted replacement material.
decision: G4 rework. Retain immutable material1 source59/review73 and correct the original texture design in a new revision. Recheck neutral/raking whole and macro views with actual source/export buffer conservation.
